text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk along the riverbank, I 
spotted Kawakami Princess receiving cheers 
from some local kids.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"—Seiyaaaaaah! This is my Princess Full 
Drive!"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yay, perfection! Amazing, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, that's roughly how it's done! Which 
technique shall I demonstrate for you 
next?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! We were just showing off the 
special moves and transformation poses 
from PreFie!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, bring on the requests! Trainer, 
if there's anything you want to see, don't 
hesitate to raise your hand!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
That's it, Sis! Trainer's here too, so 
show them that thing! Your Final Form!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ehh!? When you say Final Form—

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, my Prince! Final... 
FOOOOOOORM!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
First, shatter the ground with a stomp, 
leap into the air, and gaze into the 
prince's eyes while spinning at high 
speed—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Waltzing while gracefully gliding across 
the water, striking a pose together to 
transform— PriFi's final, ultimate form—!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
"Yay, that sounds awesome! I wanna see it 
too! Big Sis and Trainer going into their 
Final Form!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...! I-It's true, if she pulls off 
that amazing move...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (...*glance*)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Peek! Peek!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She looks at me with eyes that blatantly 
scream she wants to try it. What... should 
I do about this?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She looks at me with eyes that blatantly 
scream she wants to try it. What... should 
I do about this?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!! Now that's my Trainer for you!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I shall take charge of launching you into 
the air! Come now, position yourself in my 
arms!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: FINAL... FOOOOOORM!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And from there... a giant spin!! Thirty 
high-speed spins~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And now, the water waltz! You must take 
the next step before your feet start to 
sink~!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa... Amazing!! Sis and Trainer are 
gliding across the water~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you put your life on the line, you can 
do anything... That scene truly drove that 
lesson home for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An intense, rapid ascent followed by a 
spin...! My consciousness feels like it's 
about to fly right out of my body—!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Trainer! Entrust your body to 
my arms! Now, let us dance the water 
waltz~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it relied almost entirely on 
Kawakami Princess's sheer power... 
somehow, they successfully recreated the 
sequence of scenes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer-san! Look deep into my eyes—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...O-Oh? Trainer? Traiiiineeeer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It was a moment where so many things 
almost met their final curtain."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No way~! Please reconsider! I would 
absolutely love to give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: (Glance glance)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (...*glance!* *glance!*)
choice_data_list: What's not allowed is not allowed!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "Ehh? Boo~~..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, when I bought treats for a 
pouting Kawakami Princess and the 
children, her good mood returned 
surprisingly quickly...
